setting.editor.lineNumbers.title: Line Numbers
setting.editor.lineNumbers.description: Controls how line numbers are shown.
setting.editor.cursorBlinking.title: Cursor Blinking
setting.editor.cursorBlinking.descriptio: Animation style of the editor cursor.
setting.editor.wordWrap.title: Word Wrap
setting.editor.wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines at the edge of the editor.
setting.editor.minimap.title: Minimap
setting.editor.minimap.description: Show the minimap on the right of the editor.
setting.editor.stickyScroll.title: Sticky Scroll
setting.editor.stickyScroll.description: Keep the enclosing scopes visible at the top while scrolling.
setting.editor.renderWhitespace.title: Render Whitespace
setting.editor.renderWhitespace.descript: Show spaces and tabs as dots and arrows.
setting.files.autoSave.title: Auto Save
setting.files.autoSave.description: Save changed files by themselves: after a short delay, when you switch to another editor, or when you leave the window. An unsaved new file is never saved automatically.
setting.files.autoSaveDelay.title: Auto Save Delay
setting.files.autoSaveDelay.description: Milliseconds after the last edit before Auto Save (After Delay) saves the file.
setting.editor.formatOnSave.title: Format on Save
setting.editor.formatOnSave.description: Format a text file with its formatter just before it is saved. If there is no formatter or it fails, the file is still saved as it is.
setting.editor.defaultFormatter.title: Default Formatter
setting.editor.defaultFormatter.descript: The id of the formatter to prefer (for example prettier, biome, black, ruff, builtin.json). It is used for the languages it supports; other languages ignore it. Format Document With... can set a per-language choice.
setting.formatter.timeoutMs.title: Formatter Time Limit
setting.formatter.timeoutMs.description: An external formatter that takes longer than this many milliseconds is stopped and the text is left as it is.
setting.formatter.useProjectLocalTools.d: Run a formatter installed in the open project (node_modules/.bin, .venv, vendor/bin). Project tools are programs from the folder you opened: turn this off for folders you do not trust.
setting.formatter.useBundledTools.title: Formatters: Use Bundled Tools
setting.formatter.useBundledTools.descri: Run a formatter from OpenMind's own tools folder.
setting.formatter.useSystemTools.title: Formatters: Use System Tools
setting.formatter.useSystemTools.descrip: Also run a formatter found on the computer's PATH when nothing else provides one.
setting.search.caseSensitive.title: Match Case
setting.search.caseSensitive.description: Search is case sensitive by default.
setting.search.useRegex.title: Use Regular Expression
setting.search.useRegex.description: Search queries are regular expressions by default.
setting.search.wholeWord.title: Match Whole Word
setting.search.wholeWord.description: Search matches whole words only by default.
setting.search.include.title: Files to Include
setting.search.include.description: Default glob patterns of the search's include field, separated by commas.
setting.search.exclude.title: Files to Exclude
setting.search.exclude.description: Default glob patterns of the search's exclude field, separated by commas.
setting.search.indexing.enabled.title: Index the Workspace
setting.search.indexing.enabled.descript: Index the open folder in the background so file, text and symbol search are fast. The index stays on this machine, in the app's own folder, and may contain your project's text.
setting.search.indexing.exclude.title: Index: Files to Exclude
setting.search.indexing.exclude.descript: Glob patterns of files and folders the index never reads, separated by commas (node_modules, .git, target, dist and build are always skipped).
setting.search.indexing.maxFileSizeKb.de: Files larger than this many kilobytes are listed by name but their text is not indexed.
setting.search.indexing.useGitignore.des: Leave out files that .gitignore files exclude. (.openmindignore files are always honoured.)
setting.search.indexing.indexHiddenFiles: Index files and folders whose names start with a dot.
setting.ai.enabled.title: Enable AI Features
setting.ai.enabled.description: Show the AI panel and AI commands while at least one AI provider is enabled. Turn it off to hide all AI features (providers and history are kept).
setting.ai.defaultProvider.title: Default Provider
setting.ai.defaultProvider.description: Id of the provider the AI panel selects first. It is set from the AI provider manager.
setting.ai.defaultModel.title: Default Model
setting.ai.defaultModel.description: The model used first when the default provider has none chosen. It is set from the AI provider manager.
setting.ai.confirmBeforeOnlineRequest.de: Ask before any text leaves this computer for an online AI provider, naming the provider and what is sent. Requests to a server on this computer are never asked about.
setting.ai.saveConversationHistory.title: Save Conversation History
setting.ai.saveConversationHistory.descr: Keep AI conversations on this computer (in the app's own folder) so they are there after a restart. When off, a chat lasts until you close it.
setting.terminal.fontSize.title: Font Size
setting.terminal.fontSize.description: Font size of the integrated terminal in pixels.
setting.terminal.fontFamily.title: Font Family
setting.terminal.fontFamily.description: Font family list of the integrated terminal.
setting.terminal.cursorBlink.title: Cursor Blink
setting.terminal.scrollback.title: Scrollback
setting.terminal.scrollback.description: Number of lines a terminal keeps.
setting.run.saveBeforeRun.title: Save Before Run
setting.run.saveBeforeRun.description: Save the file before Run Code runs it. When off, a file with unsaved changes can't be run.
setting.run.clearOutputBeforeRun.title: Clear Output Before Run
setting.run.clearOutputBeforeRun.descrip: Clear the language's Output channel each time Run Code starts.
setting.git.autoRefresh.title: Auto Refresh
setting.git.autoRefresh.description: Refresh Source Control when the window gets focus and when files change.
setting.git.showBranchInStatusBar.title: Show Branch in Status Bar
setting.git.showBranchInStatusBar.descri: Show the current branch in the status bar.
setting.lsp.enabled.title: Enable Language Servers
setting.lsp.enabled.description: Start language servers for files in the open folder. Turning it off stops the running ones.
setting.lsp.verboseLogging.title: Verbose Logging
setting.lsp.verboseLogging.description: Write every message exchanged with a language server to the LSP output channel.
setting.debug.stopOnEntry.title: Stop on Entry
setting.debug.stopOnEntry.description: Pause at the first line when a debug session starts.
setting.debug.openConsoleOnStart.title: Open Debug Console on Start
setting.debug.openConsoleOnStart.descrip: Show the Debug Console panel when a debug session starts (off: the panel opens only when you open it).
setting.extensions.allowSystemNode.title: Allow System Node.js for Extensions
setting.extensions.allowSystemNode.descr: Run the extension host with a Node.js found on this computer when OpenMind's portable Node.js is not installed. It is always labelled as the system Node.js.
setting.extensions.marketplace.autoFetch: Load the Popular list from Open VSX (open-vsx.org) whenever the Extensions view is shown (not at launch). Turn it off to contact the marketplace only when you search, load Popular, open an extension page or install.
setting.assembly.architecture.title: Architecture
setting.assembly.architecture.descriptio: What Run Code builds assembly files for: x86-64 (NASM -f win64, the 64-bit linker) or x86 (NASM -f win32, the Assembly runtime's optional x86 toolchain).
setting.assembly.extraAssemblerArgs.desc: Arguments added to every NASM (or, for .s files, gcc) command Run Code uses, for example -w+all or -g. Split like a command line; nothing runs through a shell.
setting.assembly.extraLinkerArgs.title: Extra Linker Arguments
setting.assembly.extraLinkerArgs.descrip: Arguments added to the gcc command that links the program, for example -lgdi32 or -mwindows. Split like a command line; nothing runs through a shell.
setting.assembly.enableLanguageServer.de: Use asm-lsp for assembly files: completion, hover documentation, symbols, navigation and NASM problems on save. Turn it off to keep only highlighting and Run Code.
setting.php.server.defaultPort.title: Default Port
setting.php.server.defaultPort.descripti: Port the PHP server uses until you choose another one in the PHP control panel.
setting.php.tray.hideOnClose.title: Keep Servers Running in the Tray
setting.php.tray.hideOnClose.description: Closing the main window while a PHP, MariaDB or phpMyAdmin server runs hides the app to the system tray instead of quitting.
setting.network.proxy.mode.title: Proxy
setting.network.proxy.mode.description: How programs OpenMind starts (terminals, Run Code, tasks, Git, package managers, downloads) reach the network. No Proxy changes nothing. Use System Proxy uses the proxy Windows or the environment already names. Manual Proxy uses the addresses below. Only processes OpenMind starts are affected; Windows' own settings are never changed.
setting.network.proxy.http.title: HTTP Proxy
setting.network.proxy.http.description: Manual proxy for http:// addresses, as host:port or http://host:port. Put the user name and password in Network: Proxy Settings, not here.
setting.network.proxy.https.title: HTTPS Proxy
setting.network.proxy.https.description: Manual proxy for https:// addresses. Empty: the HTTP proxy is used for https:// too.
setting.network.proxy.socks.title: SOCKS Proxy
setting.network.proxy.socks.description: Optional SOCKS5 proxy (socks5://host:port), passed as ALL_PROXY. Not every tool supports SOCKS.
setting.network.proxy.noProxy.title: No Proxy For
setting.network.proxy.noProxy.descriptio: Comma-separated hosts that are reached directly (for example intranet.local, .corp). localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 are always direct.
setting.deployment.advertiseOnLan.title: Offer This Installation on the Local Network
setting.deployment.advertiseOnLan.descri: Answer other computers on this local network that look for OpenMind Studio (Help > Network Deployment): a shared network installation is announced by its network path, and the signed packages in deploy\packages next to the program are offered for download. Only versions, architectures, sizes, checksums and signatures are sent — never settings, projects, credentials or this computer's name. Off: this computer answers no one (it can still look for others).
setting.network.gateway.enabled.title: Route Package Downloads Through OpenMind
setting.network.gateway.enabled.descript: Point pip, npm, pnpm, Go, Git and Cargo in processes OpenMind starts at its local package gateway, which downloads through the same route as the Runtime Manager (the proxy in force). A tool you configured yourself keeps your settings. Program code (requests, fetch) is never routed.
setting.network.goProxy.title: Go Module Proxy
setting.network.goProxy.description: The module proxy OpenMind's package gateway fetches Go modules from (https only). Empty: proxy.golang.org. Checksums are always verified against sum.golang.org.
setting.network.testUrl.title: Connection Test Address
setting.network.testUrl.description: The address Test Connection requests (http or https). Nothing is contacted until you press Test.
setting.collaboration.displayName.title: Display Name
setting.collaboration.displayName.descri: The name people in a room see next to your cursor and in the member list. It is not an identity: members are told apart by their key fingerprint.
setting.collaboration.signalingUrl.title: Signaling Server
setting.collaboration.signalingUrl.descr: Address of the signaling relay rooms use to reach each other (wss://, or ws:// only on this computer). It only passes connection offers between computers: no code, files, room history or Room Codes go through it. Empty: rooms can't connect across networks.
setting.collaboration.localNetwork.title: Local Network
setting.collaboration.localNetwork.descr: Find and join rooms on the same local network directly, with no Internet, signaling server, STUN or TURN: a hosted room is announced on the local network (only a code-derived tag and a port, never the Room Code) and computers there connect to each other directly. Off: rooms use only the signaling server.
setting.collaboration.stunUrls.title: STUN Servers
setting.collaboration.stunUrls.descripti: Comma-separated STUN addresses (stun:host:port) that help two computers find a direct route to each other. Empty: none is used.
setting.collaboration.turnUrls.title: TURN Servers
setting.collaboration.turnUrls.descripti: Comma-separated TURN relays (turn:host:port, or turns:host:443?transport=tcp for networks that allow only web traffic) used when no direct route works. Empty: none is used.
setting.collaboration.turnUsername.title: TURN User Name
setting.collaboration.turnUsername.descr: User name for the TURN relays above. The password is stored separately, encrypted for your Windows account, never in this file.
setting.collaboration.sfuUrl.title: Classroom Media Server
setting.collaboration.sfuUrl.description: Address of a self-hosted media server for classroom voice (wss://host for a server on the Internet; ws://address:7880 only on the local network). Empty: classroom voice uses the server this computer can run itself. Only the room's Owner needs it.
setting.collaboration.sfuApiKey.title: Classroom Media Server API Key
setting.collaboration.sfuApiKey.descript: API key of the media server above. Its secret is stored separately, encrypted for your Windows account, never in this file, and never sent to other members.
setting.network.offline.useWheelhouse.de: Let pip in processes OpenMind starts also look in the imported offline wheels (PIP_FIND_LINKS). pip's own configuration is not changed.
setting.workbench.colorTheme.title: Color Theme
setting.workbench.colorTheme.description: Colors of the workbench, the editor and the terminal. System follows Windows.
setting.workbench.iconTheme.title: Icon Theme
setting.workbench.iconTheme.description: The icons in the Explorer, tabs and search. The built-in themes are bundled with the app; an extension's icon theme uses the images inside that extension. Nothing is downloaded.
setting.workbench.iconTheme.option.minim: Minimal (one file icon, no folder icons)
setting.workbench.productIconTheme.title: Product Icon Theme
setting.workbench.productIconTheme.descr: The icons used by workbench buttons and views.
setting.workbench.language.title: Display Language
setting.workbench.language.description: The language of OpenMind Studio's own menus, dialogs and messages. System Default follows the language of Windows; English is used for anything a language doesn't translate. Code, file paths and extensions keep their own text.
setting.workbench.welcomeOnStartup.title: Show Welcome Page on Startup
setting.workbench.welcomeOnStartup.descr: Open the Welcome page when the app starts.
setting.updates.automatic.title: Automatic Updates
setting.updates.automatic.description: Check for new versions of OpenMind Studio, download them in the background and install them when you close the app or choose Restart to Update. Every update is checked against OpenMind's signature before it is installed. Off: you are only told that a new version exists.
settings.language.appliesNow: The language changes at once. Monaco's own editor widgets (find box, command palette) stay in English.

settings.row.resetWorkspaceTitle: Remove this setting from the workspace settings file (default: {value})
settings.row.overridden: The open folder overrides this in its workspace settings, so that value is the one in force here.

settings.tab.workspaceFileProblem: The workspace settings file has a problem, so its values are ignored and it will not be changed: {error}

databaseError.heading: OpenMind Studio couldn't start
databaseError.unreadable: OpenMind Studio couldn't open its local database, and the details couldn't be read either: {error}
databaseError.backUpExplained: This moves the database files into a new backup folder inside {folder} and starts OpenMind Studio with a new, empty database. Recent files, sessions, window sizes, saved AI keys and the MariaDB password stay in the backup. Your projects, settings files, runtimes and extensions are not touched. Nothing is deleted.
databaseError.moved: The database was moved to {folder}. Nothing was deleted.
databaseError.kind.checksumMismatch.titl: The local database doesn't match this build
databaseError.kind.checksumMismatch.expl: OpenMind Studio could not open the local database because migration {version}'s checksum does not match this build. This can happen if a previous development build used different SQL file line endings or a different version of that migration. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.unknownMigration.titl: The local database was made by a newer OpenMind Studio
databaseError.kind.unknownMigration.expl: The database has an update (migration {version}) that this version doesn't know, so it was probably created or updated by a newer OpenMind Studio. This version won't change it. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.partialMigration.titl: An earlier database update didn't finish
databaseError.kind.partialMigration.expl: Migration {version} was started earlier and never finished (the app may have been stopped while it ran). OpenMind Studio won't guess how to complete it. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.migrationFailed.title: The local database couldn't be updated
databaseError.kind.migrationFailed.expla: Updating the database to this version (migration {version}) failed. Your data was not deleted.
Updating the database to this version failed. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.locked.title: The local database is in use
databaseError.kind.locked.explanation: Another program holds the database — often another OpenMind Studio started from this same folder. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.inUseElsewhere.title: This data is in use on another computer
databaseError.kind.inUseElsewhere.explan: OpenMind Studio on another computer has this database open right now, through a shared folder. Two computers using one database at the same time can damage it, so this start didn't open it. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.corrupt.title: The local database file is damaged
databaseError.kind.corrupt.explanation: The database file is damaged or isn't a SQLite database. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.readOnly.title: The local database can't be opened or written
databaseError.kind.readOnly.explanation: OpenMind Studio needs to read and write its data folder, which is next to the program. The folder may be read-only, on a disconnected drive, or blocked by permissions. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.diskFull.title: The disk is full
databaseError.kind.diskFull.explanation: The database couldn't be written because the disk is full. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.other.title: The local database couldn't be opened
databaseError.kind.other.explanation: OpenMind Studio couldn't open its local database. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.step.exitAndUse: Exit, and start the OpenMind Studio build that last used this folder.
databaseError.step.backUp: Back Up and Start Fresh moves the database into a backup folder and starts with a new one (recent files, sessions and saved keys stay in the backup).
databaseError.step.useNewer: Exit, and use the newer version of OpenMind Studio.
databaseError.step.reportKept: Copy Error Details and report it with the database kept.
databaseError.step.closeOther: Close the other copy of OpenMind Studio, then start it again.
databaseError.step.closeOtherComputer: Close OpenMind Studio on the other computer, then start it again.
databaseError.step.ownDataPerComputer: If several computers should use this folder at the same time, each needs its own data: install it as a network installation (Recommended for All Users), or set up this copy for All users / Multi-computer.
databaseError.step.restoreBackup: Restore the file from a backup of this folder if you have one.
databaseError.step.checkWritable: Check that the folder is writable (not a read-only drive or a protected location such as Program Files), then start again.
databaseError.step.freeSpace: Free some space on this drive, then start again.
databaseError.step.report: Copy Error Details and report it.

network.lead: The proxy applies only to programs OpenMind starts (terminals, Run Code, tasks, Git, package managers, runtime and extension downloads). Windows' proxy, PATH and the tools' own configuration are never changed.
network.policy: OpenMind uses only the proxy you set or the one Windows already uses. Package tools in its terminals download through its local package gateway over that route; program code is never routed. It does not bypass firewalls, captive portals or network rules, never turns off certificate checks, and contacts nothing until you press Test or start a download.
